title: StyleProfile
description: A client's brand invariants (PRD REQ-060/061; decisions.md D-26): the hard half only — colours, fonts, logo rules, prohibitions, and tone. Phase 0 is invariants, hand-authored per client, injected into propose/plan prompts and caption rendering. LEARNED tendencies (pacing, hook preference, caption density) with confidence-by-field are deliberately out of scope until Phase 1 (REQ-061 second half) — a schema that cannot hold a learned tendency cannot silently treat a preference as an invariant. Versioned and user-approved (PRD §5.180); `approval` null marks a draft placeholder still awaiting the D-26 owner inputs.

changelog.reason: Initial v1 (Phase 3, tech-spec §15 step 5). Invariants only by construction: no confidence fields and no learned-preference block exist to fill, so a Phase 0 profile cannot overreach into Phase 1 territory. `prohibitedClaims` here are brand-level (every job for this account inherits them), distinct from JobBrief.prohibitedClaims which are per-job.

accountId.description: The account this profile governs — the same stable owner-issued identifier as JobBrief.accountId (D-36). A profile is selected for a job by matching this.

profileVersion.description: Semantic version of THIS client's profile content (distinct from the schema's version). A RenderManifest records the exact profileVersion it rendered against (REQ-080 determinism).

approval.title: ProfileApproval
approval.description: User approval (PRD §5.180 'user-approved'), or null for a draft/placeholder profile. A tagged nullable so 'approved by a named human at a time' and 'placeholder awaiting owner inputs (D-26)' are distinct — an unapproved profile is usable for implementation fixtures but is surfaced as a draft.

colours.description: Brand colour invariants (REQ-060/061). Injected into caption and background treatment; a hard invariant, not a learned tendency.

hex.description: sRGB hex. Six digits, no alpha — brand colours are opaque.

fonts.description: Brand font invariants (REQ-060). Each records whether commercial rights are on file — a brand font without recorded rights cannot be used in a render (PRD §10.8.4); Inter (OFL, D-29) is the fallback.

rightsRecorded.description: True only if commercial-use rights are on file. False means the renderer must fall back to the OFL default rather than use this family.

logoRules.title: LogoRules
logoRules.description: Logo usage invariants (REQ-060 'logo use / logo rules').

mustAppear.description: Whether every output for this brand must carry the logo.

allowedPlacements.description: Where the logo may sit. Empty is only valid when mustAppear is false; the style resolver checks that.

prohibitedTreatments.description: Things never done to the logo (recolour, stretch, rotate, drop-shadow …).

toneOfVoice.title: ToneOfVoice
toneOfVoice.description: Editorial voice invariants (REQ-060 'tone of voice, casing, emoji use'). The hard half only — descriptors plus mechanical rules a caption pass can enforce.

descriptors.description: Voice adjectives injected into prompts (e.g. `plain-spoken`, `warm`, `no hype`).

prohibitedClaims.description: Claims THIS BRAND may never make, on any job (REQ-061 legal wording / prohibited claims). A prohibited claim appearing in an EDL is a NON-WAIVABLE deterministic block (D-35/D-37). Brand-level; a job may add more via JobBrief.prohibitedClaims but may not remove these.

prohibitedTreatments.description: Editorial treatments this brand forbids (REQ-060 'explicit prohibitions') — e.g. `no fear-based hooks`, `no fake urgency`. Surfaced to the critic; those expressible as a deterministic rule may be promoted per D-37.
